prompts.name: frente_bandeja
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Production asset for Café Manie, an isometric 2D café game. Reference 1 is the approved waiter front appearance; reference 2 is his exact back appearance. Reference 3 is the approved lighting/material integration into the café. Preserve THIS same original character: adult friendly brown-haired male waiter, warm tan skin, swept brown hair, expressive brown eyes, white rolled-sleeve shirt, charcoal waistcoat with buttons, red bow tie, charcoal slim trousers, black leather shoes. Stylized polished mobile-game 3D rendered illustration, soft warm materials, not anime lines, not plastic doll. Match reference anatomy and head/body ratio.
OUTPUT is ONE square transparent PNG animation sprite sheet, precisely 3 columns by 3 rows of equal sized cells. Prefer 3072x3072 or highest supported square resolution. Exactly nine full-body instances of this same waiter, one per cell, completely inside cells with comfortable empty alpha margins. No overlaps. All nine bodies at identical scale, consistent camera, consistent light, consistent proportions and costume. Every cell has the same ground-contact baseline at 88% cell height and center-of-body horizontal anchor at 50%. Head top around 12%, character body height around 76% of cell. No text, labels, grid lines, numbers, floor, cast shadow, background or checkerboard. TRUE transparent background, clean alpha edges without white fringe. No shadow whatsoever; the game adds ground shadow separately.
Frame order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: cells 1-8 are 8 consecutive UNIQUE evenly spaced poses of ONE smooth complete in-place walk cycle (left-foot forward contact, down/recoil, passing with right foot lifted, up, right-foot forward contact, down/recoil, passing with left foot lifted, up). The ninth cell bottom right is a distinct neutral standing idle with both feet comfortably grounded. Natural heel-to-toe stepping and weight transfer; no foot sliding, levitation, exaggerated knee lift, sideways leaning or cartoon squash. Keep very small natural vertical bob but stable registration, tray hand stable when present. Loop seamlessly from cell8 to cell1.
Camera: fixed orthographic isometric view from above, about 30 degrees downward, exactly matching the reference. Full body visible, shoes fully visible and same camera angle in ALL cells.
VIEW/STATE: FRONT three-quarter, looking down-and-to-the-RIGHT of the screen. Face visible. Holding the SAME empty silver tray level in his anatomical LEFT hand, on the RIGHT side of each image as in reference1. Right arm swings subtly. Tray must be empty, fully visible, flat ellipse, smooth rim. No plate or food. All nine cells have tray, including idle.
